manager.label: Vortex
notes: Reads Vortex's own staging folders — the copies it keeps, not the ones it has deployed into your game. That is deliberate: a deployed file is a link back to the staging copy, and importing the link would leave Vortex's own copy behind.
Vortex is not touched. Its mods stay installed and deployed exactly as they are.
Vortex names its game folders with its own ids. If a game you have is missing, correcting the id in a dropped descriptor is the whole fix.
Nexus's API is per-user and Vortex has no remote API, so everything here comes from what is already on this machine.
